description: The bar chart, titled "QA-1," presents a financial evaluation comparing the performance of three models—Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our)—on a task labeled QA-1. The horizontal bars represent the proportion of correct, partially correct, and incorrect responses for each model, with the categories labeled on the vertical axis and the proportion values on the horizontal axis. The legend indicates that dark purple corresponds to "Correct," medium blue to "Partially Correct," and light blue to "Incorrect." For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the performance is broken down as 0.88 correct, 0.08 partially correct, and 0.04 incorrect. Both EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our) show identical performance, with 0.96 correct, 0 partially correct, and 0.04 incorrect. The bars are sorted in descending order of the "Correct" score, with Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B having the lowest "Correct" score and the other two models tied for the highest. The "Partially Correct" category is only present for Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, while "Incorrect" is present for all three models.
